copy.tagline: 遵循测试驱动开发流程分阶段完成开发任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按测试驱动方式规范地完成开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Follow a test-driven development workflow to complete development tasks in phases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to follow a strict test-driven workflow in your development tasks.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Conductor 的 TDD 流程做任务：先写失败的测试（RED），再改代码，处理阶段检查点，管理 git 提交与 notes，并把进度记录到 plan.md。
howto.when: 当你要按 Conductor 的 TDD 流程实现计划中的任务、完成阶段检查点，或管理任务的 git 提交时接管。

say.text: 按 TDD 流程实现 plan.md 里的下一个任务
say.note: 会先写失败测试再实现

say.text: 帮这个阶段做一次 git 提交并补上 git notes
say.note: 一次提交只放一个逻辑变更

say.text: 核对这个任务的检查点和验证协议
say.note: 逐项检查质量门后再标完成

howto.what_en: Claude implements tasks following Conductor's TDD workflow: writes failing tests first, then code, handles phase checkpoints, manages git commits and notes, and records progress in plan.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you implement tasks from a track's plan.md, follow the TDD red-green-refactor cycle, complete phase checkpoints, or manage git commits for tasks.

say_en.text: Implement the next task in plan.md using the TDD workflow
say_en.note: Writes failing tests first, then code

say_en.text: Commit this phase and add git notes for the change
Check this task's checkpoint and the verification protocol
